verdict.rationale: The NVIDIA H200 is a data-center GPU, a hardware accelerator with no user-facing interface where a user's data could be shown AI-generated insights or suggestions. This story is a category error for this kind of product. The bundled NVIDIA AI Enterprise/NIM software and cuML/cuDF libraries are developer building blocks for building such applications, not an in-product insights feature, so they do not make the axis applicable.
